defective_pattern: Hardcoded fabricated search strings and character-by-character regex XML tag insertion without verifying replacements count.
why_defective: Regex fails to match across whitespace, half-spaces, and Word XML runs. Lack of assertion on replacements count leads to silent passes and false completion reporting.
observed_symptoms: False completion reporting despite no XML changes
corrective_remedy: Extract exact strings from source document; use robust XML DOM paragraph/run text inspection; assert replacements_count > 0 on every substitution to fail fast instead of failing silently.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detect script modifications to docx xml without asserting replacements
